objective: At least 10 percent net in every complete calendar year; 20 percent upper reference not rejection; reference capital 1000 USD
scope: New retrospective allocation mechanisms; previous trials retained. Known history is not untouched. No performance computed for this registration before this timestamp.

inputs.provider: Yahoo Finance through yfinance; existing private snapshot
inputs.joint_calendar: Must exactly match across all six after common start; no backfill or pre-inception synthesis
inputs.price_model: Adjusted wealth units: close=Adj Close; open=Open*Adj Close/Close. No added dividends; fractional units are not literal shares.

policies.name: Capped minimum variance
policies.rule: Minimize w.T Sigma w, sum(w)=1, 0<=w<=0.5 on five risk assets

policies.name: Equal risk contribution
policies.rule: Positive normalized weights with equal w_i*(Sigma*w)_i on five risk assets

policies.name: Ratcheting floor SPY
policies.floor: 0.8 * max(1000, all completed account closing NAVs)

policies.name: Ratcheting floor equal five
policies.floor: 0.8 * max(1000, all completed account closing NAVs)

policies.name: Finite-grid wealth mixture
policies.rule: 126 nonnegative six-asset weight vectors k/4 with integer sum(k)=4. Uniform prior. Each completed monthly price-relative vector x multiplies each virtual expert wealth by b dot x. Target weighted average of b by accumulated gross virtual wealth, computed in log space.

policies.name: Exponentiated gradient
policies.rule: Initialize uniform six-asset weights. For each completed monthly x, w_new_i proportional to w_i * exp(0.05*x_i/(w dot x)). Normalize.

account.fees: Proportional costs on every buy/sell and terminal liquidation, funded by same account; use reviewed self-financing rebalance solver
account.marks: Opening before/after costs, closing before/after terminal costs; intraday extremes unobserved
account.first_entry: First observed session of each complete window using last already knowable signal and fresh cash; buy-and-hold only first entry. All positions liquidated at final close with fees.
account.practical_limits: Fractional adjusted-unit economics; no proof of broker fractionals, minimum tickets, actual fills, settlement, cash dividend dates, taxes or subscription costs. Record sub-dollar traded legs and turnover; do not omit depleted accounts.

covariance.failure: Invalid or degenerate required covariance / solver nonconvergence fails visibly; no silent replacement rule.
covariance.timing: Completed daily returns through latest completed month-end only; execute next observed open

insurance.rule: e=clip(3*(previous_completed_close_NAV-floor)/previous_completed_close_NAV,0,1); put e in registered risk sleeve and 1-e in BIL; apply 0.98 total target budget once
insurance.reference: NAV is from this actual cost/window scenario. First trade uses initial1000 and800floor. Subsequent signals computed from previous completed close, never current opening wealth. No annual reset.
insurance.floor_risk: Floor is an exposure input, not a guaranteed protection: overnight gaps, trading costs and BIL losses may breach it.

online.start: First common month-end May2007 gives initial state; first complete monthly return June2007. Inherit market-signal state, never account wealth or positions.
online.virtual_experts: Gross close-to-close monthly constant-weight experts used solely as signals. Their performance is not a claimed costed tradable result. Actual account executes next-open targets and pays all fees.

selection.freeze: Compute all training accounts and save selection before any evaluation/full performance. No annual adaptive selector or parameter search.

stopping: No threshold, weight, asset or cost changes after viewing this batch. New genuinely distinct hypotheses need new registration. Software defects require retained prior outputs and documented correction. No automatic strategy promotion.
